summary: Use assist.org's anonymous public web endpoints and remove every API-key requirement from the CLI and MCP surface.
reason: The intended integration is the public ASSIST website contract, not the separately licensed prod.assistng.org API. The public site requires an anonymous XSRF bootstrap but no user credential.
validated_outcome: Full Go suite passes; ten live public route shapes return anonymous JSON; agreement list and advisor workflow return 70 reports for the verified pair/year; MCP list contains only public typed endpoints and current command mirrors.
